name: Blade
desc: A sworn sword. Hits hard, hits often, and gets better at both.
primeHint: higher ST means more attacks hitting and harder hits landing

name: Warden
desc: An oath-bound shieldhand of the Quiet Flame. Steady, blessed, hard to curse.
primeHint: ST drives attack and damage; high CN adds hit points at each level

name: Knave
desc: A lock-whisperer and shadow-stander. Finds the trap before the trap finds you.
primeHint: DX improves armour class, missile accuracy, and trap-work effectiveness

name: Strider
desc: A fen-hunter who knows where the throat is. Sometimes the first cut is the last.
primeHint: DX sharpens armour class and missile aim; crit chance grows each level

name: Fistwright
desc: An order of bare-knuckle ascetics. Wears little, breaks much.
primeHint: ST powers unarmed damage and attack rolls; bare fists scale with level

name: Skald
desc: A singer of the old verses. With an instrument in hand, the song does the fighting.
primeHint: DX keeps a Skald alive to keep singing; songs need an instrument equipped

name: Hexen
desc: A crook-fingered school of dread and false light. Their spells lie until the lie draws blood.
primeHint: IQ gives more spell points at creation and determines SP bonuses per level

name: Lorist
desc: A reader of the deep ledgers of the world. Wards, light, and the naming of hidden things.
primeHint: IQ gives more spell points at creation and determines SP bonuses per level

name: Stormcaller
desc: The third school. They went out onto the fen in thunder and came back speaking it.
primeHint: IQ gives more spell points at creation and determines SP bonuses per level

name: Riddlemaster
desc: Last of the four doors. A Riddlemaster may learn every school, and the Needle will not open without one.
primeHint: IQ gives more spell points at creation and determines SP bonuses per level
